title: Horizontal exits.
officialText:
A listed smoke damper designed to resist the passage of smoke shall be provided at each point
that a duct or air transfer opening penetrates a fire wall that serves as a horizontal exit.
Exception: Smoke dampers shall not be required in ducts where the air continues to move and the air-handling system installed
is arranged to prevent recirculation of exhaust or return air under fire emergency conditions.
